title: What, who, by when.
kit: Block 2 · the idea
What, who, by when.
Action item
An action has three parts: what will be done, who does it, and by when. An idea that nobody agreed to is not an action.
“Someone will look into the laptops.”
“Hamad sets up 18 laptop accounts by Wednesday 2 December.”
Missing an owner or a date? It is not an action yet.

title: Four problems to look for.
kit: Block 6 · four problems
Four problems to look for.
Find them first. Fix them tomorrow.
Problem
What it looks like
Ask
Delay
A step waits for days, often for one person.
How long does it wait, and for whom?
Duplicated effort
The same information is typed, printed or checked more than once.
Who types or checks it again?
Unclear ownership
Nobody is sure who does the next step, or who chases it.
Who does the next step? Who chases it?
Repetitive step
The same manual action every time, with no judgment in it.
Is there any judgment in it?
